pictures.author: gargudojr
pictures.observations: Close entrance view shows dense horizontal metal louvers, broad recessed entrance/glazed lower band and vertical display pylons; warm sunset lighting is not a gold material. No sponsor text, copied branding, crowd, traffic or event artwork.

pictures.author: Sebas
pictures.observations: Open bowl with three main seating tiers, intermediate suite/ribbon bands, radial aisles, large corner screens and continuous lighting/truss rim. Temporary soccer configuration, crowds, sponsor text and live screen pixels are not copied. Model uses a neutral permanent-football configuration.

pictures.author: MiracleMiles
pictures.observations: Recent opposite exterior corroborates silver horizontal louvers, open steel lighting rim and shallow continuous oval shell. Temporary FIFA decoration/tents/parking contents are excluded; this is a bounded stadium asset rather than the entire sports complex.

currentRoundInspection.scope: Specific MetLife Stadium: native asymmetric oval shell and field opening, three stepped open seating tiers/radial concrete aisles, suite/concourse bands, neutral standard football field/linework/two goalposts, four supported inward-facing corner boards, closed silver horizontal louver shell/recessed glazed entry bands/four major portal groups, continuous open steel lighting rim. Shared concrete/paint/window-grid/canvas graphs; canvas grain is a low-frequency artificial-turf approximation. No roof over field, furnished service interior, crowd, copied live screen/text/team/sponsor atlas, temporary event setup, other venue or whole parking lot/platform.
